george.blurb: Long-range kinetic sniper. Slow, deliberate, every shot a tracer that pierces armor.
george.strengths: Longest engagement range. Massive single-shot damage. Bullet Storm unleashes an absurd-cadence frenzy on demand.
george.weakness: Slow base fire cadence — packs of swarmers slip past between shots. Kinetic-resistant armored chassis shrug body hits.

abilityBlurb.0: Sniper beam. Long reach, slow cadence, huge kinetic hit.
abilityBlurb.1: Short i-frame hop; next shot is a piercing x2.5 crit.
abilityBlurb.2: Close kinetic pulse for 95 damage and a small path push.
abilityBlurb.3: Scope stance: more range and damage, slower feet, 40% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 3.5s frenzy: x7 fire rate and +50% damage.

leela.blurb: Electric skirmisher. Every shot chains. Storms tear apart anything that gets close.
leela.strengths: Highest mobility. Auto-attacks chain to two nearby targets. Storm Surge zaps every enemy in a wide ring for several seconds.
leela.weakness: Thin armor — eats hits at midrange. Electric-resistant titans absorb the kit.

abilityBlurb.0: Fast electric zap. Each shot chains to two nearby targets.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame dash; end arcs hit 3 enemies for 24 electric.
abilityBlurb.2: 4-radius electric pulse, then 4 chain hops for 35 each.
abilityBlurb.3: 3s veil: speed, fire rate, damage, and 80% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 5s storm: 4 electric arcs every 0.2s inside 7 radius.

mike.blurb: Close-range flame mech. Heavy per-shot splash plus burn DoT — turns packs into bonfires.
mike.strengths: Biggest auto-attack splash of any robot. Ignition doubles fire rate. Inferno Ring washes flame waves out in every direction.
mike.weakness: Shortest engagement range. Para and armored matriarchs vent flame at ≤0.5×.

abilityBlurb.0: Short-range flame splash. Every shot hits a small pack.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame dash that leaves a 2.6s burning coal trail.
abilityBlurb.3: 4s ignition: x2 fire rate, +30% damage, 35% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 3 expanding flame rings, 95 each, plus burn.

stan.blurb: Explosive artillery. Every shell detonates; ground pounds and giant warheads chunk packs.
stan.strengths: Every auto-attack is a splash. Ground Pound lands a 110-dmg blast. Annihilator drops a single warhead that flattens the lane.
stan.weakness: Slowest mobility — positioning drift hurts. Explosive resist on armored matriarchs softens the kit.

abilityBlurb.0: Long-range explosive shells. Slow, wide splash, high impact.
abilityBlurb.1: Short i-frame leap; landing blast deals 110 explosive.
abilityBlurb.2: 5-radius quake for 160 explosive and heavy path push.
